name: User Authentication Reliability
environment: The system operates in a typical production environment under normal and peak usage conditions.
stimulus: A sudden spike in user authentication requests due to an external event (e.g., a promotional campaign), coupled with the unavailability of one authentication component or service.
response: The system ensures uninterrupted authentication services by rerouting requests to backup components or services, maintaining an average response time of under 2 seconds, and ensuring at least 99% of requests are processed successfully.

name: Payment API Protection
stimulus: An external attacker sends malicious input (e.g., script injection) to the payment API endpoint
response: The system sanitizes and rejects the input, logs the attempt, and does not expose any sensitive data

name: Unauthorized Access Attempt
stimulus: An unauthenticated user attempts to access the order history endpoint
response: The system denies access with a 401 Unauthorized response and logs the attempt

name: Peak Load Checkout
environment: Production during Black Friday peak traffic
response: The system processes 95% of checkout requests within 2 seconds and maintains data consistency

name: Product Browsing
stimulus: A user navigates to the product listing page
response: The system loads and renders product data in the frontend within 1.5 seconds

name: Traffic Surge
stimulus: Traffic increases rapidly from 500 to 10,000 concurrent users due to a marketing campaign
response: The system auto-scales backend and frontend services, maintaining performance without manual intervention

name: Inventory Sync from Multiple Suppliers
environment: Production environment during supplier synchronization batch
stimulus: 50 external suppliers push stock updates to the inventory sync API simultaneously
response: The system processes all updates concurrently and updates internal stock records within 10 seconds

name: Inventory Race Condition
environment: Production under moderate to high traffic
stimulus: 100 users attempt to purchase the last 5 units of a product at the same time
response: The system prevents overselling by handling requests atomically and accurately reflects inventory state

name: Order Processing Failure
stimulus: A database write fails during order placement
response: The system retries the operation or rolls back changes to avoid inconsistent order states

name: Service Crash Recovery
response: The system detects the failure, restarts the service automatically, and restores availability within 30 seconds

name: Cloud Region Outage
stimulus: The primary cloud region becomes unavailable
response: The system fails over to a secondary region, restoring service within 2 minutes without data loss

name: Scaling Under Peak Load
environment: The system operates in a production environment with variable user traffic, including occasional peak loads triggered by external events.
stimulus: A sudden surge in concurrent user activity, such as 10x the average traffic within a short time window (e.g., during a flash sale or unplanned event).
response: The system dynamically scales resources to handle the increased load without degrading response times beyond 3 seconds for 95% of requests, ensuring system stability and maintaining core functionality.[scenario3.md](scenario3.md)

name: Payment Integration
stimulus: A customer completes a payment using PayPal
response: The system communicates with PayPal’s API, confirms payment, and updates order status accordingly

name: Inventory API Format Change
stimulus: An external inventory system changes its JSON response schema
response: The system adapts using schema versioning, maintains compatibility, and continues syncing stock correctly

name: First-Time Buyer Experience
stimulus: A new user tries to make a purchase without an existing account
response: The system guides the user through account creation and completes checkout without confusion or error

name: Mobile Device Navigation
stimulus: A user browses and uses filters on a smartphone
response: The system responds to user interactions with < 2s latency and maintains full responsiveness and readability

name: Cloud Deployment Rollout
stimulus: A new application version is deployed using blue-green deployment
response: The deployment completes without downtime and switches traffic seamlessly to the new version

name: Deployment Failure Rollback
stimulus: A bug is detected post-deployment via health checks
response: The system automatically rolls back to the previous version within 2 minutes and notifies the operations team

name: Order Placement Consistency
environment: The system operates in a production environment where multiple users are concurrently placing orders, with some transactions involving high-value items or limited stock.
stimulus: Simultaneous order placement requests for the same item from multiple users during a high-demand period (e.g., during a limited-time sale or product launch).
response: The system ensures consistency by processing orders sequentially or using a distributed locking mechanism, ensuring that no duplicate or conflicting orders are processed. All successful orders are confirmed within 5 seconds, and inventory levels are accurately updated in real time across all components.
